FILE: libs/nimskia/src/nimskia.nim
================================================================
## nimskia — Skia for the Yantra native engine (architecture §5).
##
## A thin Nim layer over `skia_shim.cpp`: a raster canvas over caller-owned
## pixels, rounded rects, clipping and paragraph text. Skia itself comes from
## MSYS2 (`mingw-w64-x86_64-skia`), installed into third_party/msys64.

import std/os

const shimDir = currentSourcePath().parentDir
when defined(emscripten):
  # the browser build: Skia from source, built for wasm; tools/build-web.sh passes where it is
  # (paths cannot be joined here: the target OS is not Windows, so `/` would mangle them)
  const skiaSrc {.strdefine.} = ""
  const skiaOut = skiaSrc & "/out/wasm"
  {.compile("skia_shim.cpp", "-std=c++20 -O2 -DNDEBUG -DSK_RELEASE -I\"" & skiaSrc & "\"").}
  {.passL: "\"" & skiaOut & "/libskparagraph.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libskshaper.a\" \"" & skiaOut &
    "/libskunicode_icu.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libskunicode_core.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libskia.a\" \"" & skiaOut &
    "/libicu.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libharfbuzz.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libfreetype2.a\" \"" & skiaOut &
    "/libpng.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libzlib.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libbrotli.a\" \"" & skiaOut & "/libjpeg.a\" \"" &
    skiaOut & "/libwuffs.a\"".}
else:
  const
    skiaInc = shimDir / ".." / ".." / ".." / "third_party" / "msys64" / "mingw64" / "include" / "skia"
    skiaPriv = shimDir / ".." / ".." / ".." / "third_party" / "skia-src-m143"   # see fetch_private_headers.sh
  {.compile("skia_shim.cpp", "-std=c++17 -O2 -DNDEBUG -DSK_RELEASE -I\"" & skiaInc & "\" -I\"" & skiaPriv & "\"").}
  {.passL: "-lskparagraph -lskshaper -lskunicode_icu -lskunicode_core -lskia -licuuc -licuin -lharfbuzz -lstdc++ -lgdi32 -lopengl32 -lole32 -loleaut32 -luuid -lusp10 -ldwrite -lpthread".}

type
  Canvas* = distinct pointer

proc yk_canvas_new(pixels: pointer; w, h, rowBytes: cint): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_canvas_free(c: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_clear(c: pointer; argb: uint32) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_save(c: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_restore(c: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_translate(c: pointer; x, y: cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_scale(c: pointer; s: cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_rotate(c: pointer; deg: cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_clip_rect(c: pointer; x, y, w, h: cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_rrect(c: pointer; x, y, w, h, r: cfloat; argb: uint32) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_rrect_stroke(c: pointer; x, y, w, h, r, width: cfloat; argb: uint32) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_polyline(c: pointer; xy: ptr cfloat; n: cint; width: cfloat; argb: uint32) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_text_measure(s: cstring; len: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat;
                     outH: ptr cfloat): cfloat {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_text_draw(c: pointer; s: cstring; len: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat;
                  x, y: cfloat; argb: uint32; align: cint) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_text_caret_x(s: cstring; len, bytes: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint): cfloat {.importc, cdecl.}

proc newCanvas*(pixels: pointer; w, h, rowBytes: int): Canvas =
  ## A canvas that draws straight into `pixels` (32-bit premultiplied, native order).
  Canvas(yk_canvas_new(pixels, cint(w), cint(h), cint(rowBytes)))

proc free*(c: Canvas) = yk_canvas_free(pointer(c))
proc clear*(c: Canvas; argb: uint32) = yk_clear(pointer(c), argb)
proc save*(c: Canvas) = yk_save(pointer(c))
proc restore*(c: Canvas) = yk_restore(pointer(c))
proc translate*(c: Canvas; x, y: float32) = yk_translate(pointer(c), x, y)
proc scale*(c: Canvas; s: float32) = yk_scale(pointer(c), s)
proc rotate*(c: Canvas; degrees: float32) = yk_rotate(pointer(c), degrees)  ## clockwise, about the origin
proc clipRect*(c: Canvas; x, y, w, h: float32) = yk_clip_rect(pointer(c), x, y, w, h)

proc fillRRect*(c: Canvas; x, y, w, h, r: float32; argb: uint32) =
  yk_rrect(pointer(c), x, y, w, h, r, argb)

proc strokeRRect*(c: Canvas; x, y, w, h, r, width: float32; argb: uint32) =
  yk_rrect_stroke(pointer(c), x, y, w, h, r, width, argb)

proc measureText*(s: string; size: float32; weight = 400; maxW = 0'f32): (float32, float32) =
  ## (width, height) the text needs when wrapped at `maxW` (0 = one line).
  var h: cfloat
  let w = yk_text_measure(s.cstring, cint(s.len), size, cint(weight), maxW, addr h)
  (float32(w), float32(h))

proc drawText*(c: Canvas; s: string; x, y, size: float32; argb: uint32; weight = 400;
               maxW = 0'f32; align = 0) =
  ## Draws `s` with its top-left at (x, y). align: 0 left, 1 center, 2 right (within maxW).
  yk_text_draw(pointer(c), s.cstring, cint(s.len), size, cint(weight), maxW, x, y, argb, cint(align))

proc caretX*(s: string; bytes: int; size: float32; weight = 400): float32 =
  ## Horizontal position of a caret placed after `bytes` bytes of `s`.
  yk_text_caret_x(s.cstring, cint(s.len), cint(bytes), size, cint(weight))

proc strokePolyline*(c: Canvas; pts: openArray[(float32, float32)]; width: float32; argb: uint32) =
  ## An open line through `pts`, round caps and joins (ticks, chevrons, dividers).
  if pts.len < 2: return
  var xy = newSeq[cfloat](pts.len * 2)
  for i, (x, y) in pts:
    xy[2 * i] = x
    xy[2 * i + 1] = y
  yk_polyline(pointer(c), addr xy[0], cint(pts.len), width, argb)

# --- E5: the style system ------------------------------------------------------

type TextStyle* = object
  ## Text options beyond size and weight. Zero values mean "the default".
  family*: string
  italic*: bool
  lineHeight*: float32   ## multiple of the size
  maxLines*: int         ## 0 = unlimited; otherwise ends in an ellipsis
  rtl*: bool             ## right-to-left paragraph (P9): bidi base direction, start = right
  inline*: string        ## Q3: "w,h;w,h": the boxes each U+FFFC in the text becomes (inline images, emoji)
  spans*: string         ## styled runs: "start,end,flags,argb,size;…" (bytes; flags 1 bold,
                         ## 2 italic, 4 underline, 8 strike, 16 mono; argb/size 0 = inherit)

proc fam(st: TextStyle): string =
  ## The family string the shim reads; runs travel after a record separator (0x1E), and a
  ## leading group separator (0x1D) means right-to-left.
  result = if st.spans.len == 0: st.family else: st.family & $chr(0x1e) & st.spans
  if st.inline.len > 0: result.add $chr(0x1c) & st.inline
  if st.rtl: result = $chr(0x1d) & result

proc yk_text_measure2(s: cstring; len: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat; outH: ptr cfloat;
                      family: cstring; italic: cint; lineHeight: cfloat; maxLines: cint): cfloat {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_text_draw2(c: pointer; s: cstring; len: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat;
                   x, y: cfloat; argb: uint32; align: cint;
                   family: cstring; italic: cint; lineHeight: cfloat; maxLines: cint) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_rrect_gradient(c: pointer; x, y, w, h, r: cfloat; a, b: uint32; angle: cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_shadow(c: pointer; x, y, w, h, r, dx, dy, blur: cfloat; argb: uint32) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_save_alpha(c: pointer; alpha: cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_svg_path(c: pointer; d: cstring; x, y, scale, strokeWidth: cfloat; argb: uint32) {.importc, cdecl.}

proc measureText*(s: string; size: float32; weight: int; maxW: float32; st: TextStyle): (float32, float32) =
  var h: cfloat
  let w = yk_text_measure2(s.cstring, cint(s.len), size, cint(weight), maxW, addr h,
                           st.fam.cstring, cint(st.italic), st.lineHeight, cint(st.maxLines))
  (float32(w), float32(h))

proc drawText*(c: Canvas; s: string; x, y, size: float32; argb: uint32; weight: int; maxW: float32;
               align: int; st: TextStyle) =
  yk_text_draw2(pointer(c), s.cstring, cint(s.len), size, cint(weight), maxW, x, y, argb, cint(align),
                st.fam.cstring, cint(st.italic), st.lineHeight, cint(st.maxLines))

proc fillGradient*(c: Canvas; x, y, w, h, r: float32; a, b: uint32; angle: float32) =
  ## A linear gradient from `a` to `b`; angle in degrees, 90 = top to bottom.
  yk_rrect_gradient(pointer(c), x, y, w, h, r, a, b, angle)

proc shadow*(c: Canvas; x, y, w, h, r, dx, dy, blur: float32; argb: uint32) =
  ## A soft shadow for a rounded rect (drawn before the rect itself).
  yk_shadow(pointer(c), x, y, w, h, r, dx, dy, blur, argb)

proc saveAlpha*(c: Canvas; alpha: float32) =
  ## Fades everything until the matching `restore` as one layer.
  yk_save_alpha(pointer(c), alpha)

proc svgPath*(c: Canvas; d: string; x, y, scale, strokeWidth: float32; argb: uint32) =
  ## SVG path data at (x, y) scaled by `scale`; stroked when strokeWidth > 0.
  yk_svg_path(pointer(c), d.cstring, x, y, scale, strokeWidth, argb)

# --- T1: text editing geometry -------------------------------------------------

proc yk_text_caret(s: cstring; len, bytes: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat; family: cstring;
                   italic: cint; lineHeight: cfloat; x, y, h: ptr cfloat) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_text_hit(s: cstring; len: cint; x, y, size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat; family: cstring;
                 italic: cint; lineHeight: cfloat): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_text_rects(s: cstring; len, a, b: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat; family: cstring;
                   italic: cint; lineHeight: cfloat; outp: ptr cfloat; maxRects: cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}

proc caretAt*(s: string; bytes: int; size: float32; weight: int; maxW: float32; st: TextStyle): (float32, float32, float32) =
  ## Where the caret goes after `bytes` bytes of `s` laid out at `maxW` (0 = one line): x, top, height.
  var x, y, h: cfloat
  yk_text_caret(s.cstring, cint(s.len), cint(bytes), size, cint(weight), maxW, st.fam.cstring, cint(st.italic),
                st.lineHeight, addr x, addr y, addr h)
  (float32(x), float32(y), float32(h))

proc textHit*(s: string; x, y, size: float32; weight: int; maxW: float32; st: TextStyle): int =
  ## The byte offset in `s` nearest to point (x, y) of the laid-out text.
  int(yk_text_hit(s.cstring, cint(s.len), x, y, size, cint(weight), maxW, st.fam.cstring, cint(st.italic),
                  st.lineHeight))

proc textRects*(s: string; a, b: int; size: float32; weight: int; maxW: float32; st: TextStyle): seq[(float32, float32, float32, float32)] =
  ## Rectangles covering bytes [a, b) of the laid-out text: a selection highlight.
  var buf: array[256, cfloat]
  let n = yk_text_rects(s.cstring, cint(s.len), cint(a), cint(b), size, cint(weight), maxW, st.fam.cstring,
                        cint(st.italic), st.lineHeight, addr buf[0], 64)
  for i in 0 ..< int(n): result.add (float32(buf[4*i]), float32(buf[4*i+1]), float32(buf[4*i+2]), float32(buf[4*i+3]))

# --- FX1: effects ------------------------------------------------------------------

proc yk_save_fx(c: pointer; x, y, w, h, r, blur, backdrop: cfloat; blend: cint; saturate, brightness, contrast,
                alpha: cfloat): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_shader_rrect(c: pointer; src: cstring; x, y, w, h, r, time: cfloat; err: cstring; cap: cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_shader_uses_time(src: cstring): cint {.importc, cdecl.}

type Fx* = object
  ## A node's effects. Zero values mean "none".
  blur*, backdrop*: float32       ## px: blur of the node itself; blur of what is behind it (glass)
  blend*: int                     ## an SkBlendMode; -1 = normal
  saturate*, brightness*, contrast*: float32   ## 1 = unchanged
  alpha*: float32

proc saveFx*(c: Canvas; x, y, w, h, r: float32; fx: Fx): int =
  ## Starts a layer with the effects; call `restore` the returned number of times.
  int(yk_save_fx(pointer(c), x, y, w, h, r, fx.blur, fx.backdrop, cint(fx.blend), fx.saturate, fx.brightness,
                 fx.contrast, fx.alpha))

proc shaderRRect*(c: Canvas; src: string; x, y, w, h, r, time: float32): string =
  ## Fills a rounded rect with an SkSL shader ("" on success, else the compile error).
  var err = newString(512)
  if yk_shader_rrect(pointer(c), src.cstring, x, y, w, h, r, time, err.cstring, cint(err.len)) == 1: ""
  else: $err.cstring

proc shaderUsesTime*(src: string): int = int(yk_shader_uses_time(src.cstring))
  ## 1 if the shader reads `time` (it animates), 0 if not, -1 if it does not compile.

# --- D1: PDF documents -------------------------------------------------------------

proc yk_pdf_open(path, title, author: cstring): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_pdf_page(h: pointer; w, hgt: cfloat): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_pdf_end_page(h: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_pdf_close(h: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}

type PdfDoc* = object
  h: pointer
  pages*: int

proc openPdf*(path: string; title = ""; author = ""): PdfDoc =
  ## A PDF to draw pages into (vector: shapes stay shapes, text stays text).
  let h = yk_pdf_open(path.cstring, title.cstring, author.cstring)
  if h == nil: raise newException(IOError, "cannot write " & path)
  PdfDoc(h: h)

proc beginPage*(d: var PdfDoc; w, h: float32): Canvas =
  ## A page of w x h points (1/72 inch); draw it with the canvas, then `endPage`.
  ## The canvas belongs to the document: do not `free` it.
  inc d.pages
  Canvas(yk_pdf_page(d.h, w, h))

proc endPage*(d: PdfDoc) = yk_pdf_end_page(d.h)

proc close*(d: var PdfDoc) =
  if d.h != nil:
    yk_pdf_close(d.h)
    d.h = nil

# --- U5: the GPU ---------------------------------------------------------------------

proc yk_gpu_new(): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_gpu_free(ctx: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_gpu_window_surface(ctx: pointer; w, h: cint): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_gpu_offscreen(ctx: pointer; w, h: cint): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_surface_canvas(s: pointer): pointer {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_surface_free(s: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_gpu_flush(ctx: pointer; sync: cint) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_surface_read(s, pixels: pointer; w, h: cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}

type
  Gpu* = distinct pointer        ## Skia's GPU context on the current OpenGL context
  Surface* = distinct pointer    ## something a GPU frame is drawn into

proc newGpu*(): Gpu = Gpu(yk_gpu_new())
  ## Needs an OpenGL context current on this thread (nimsdl3 `openGlWindow`).
proc isNil*(g: Gpu): bool = pointer(g) == nil
proc isNil*(s: Surface): bool = pointer(s) == nil
proc free*(g: Gpu) = yk_gpu_free(pointer(g))
proc windowSurface*(g: Gpu; w, h: int): Surface = Surface(yk_gpu_window_surface(pointer(g), cint(w), cint(h)))
proc offscreen*(g: Gpu; w, h: int): Surface = Surface(yk_gpu_offscreen(pointer(g), cint(w), cint(h)))
proc canvas*(s: Surface): Canvas = Canvas(yk_surface_canvas(pointer(s)))
  ## The surface's canvas (owned by the surface: do not `free` it).
proc free*(s: Surface) = yk_surface_free(pointer(s))
proc flush*(g: Gpu; wait = false) = yk_gpu_flush(pointer(g), cint(wait))
proc readPixels*(s: Surface; pixels: pointer; w, h: int): bool = yk_surface_read(pointer(s), pixels, cint(w), cint(h)) == 1
# --- Image support (N1) --------------------------------------------------------

proc yk_write_png(path: cstring; w, h: cint; argb: uint32): bool {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_image_info(path: cstring; outW, outH: ptr cint): bool {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_draw_image(c: pointer; path: cstring; x, y, w, h, r: cfloat; fit: cint) {.importc, cdecl.}

proc writePng*(path: string; w, h: int; argb: uint32): bool =
  ## Creates a solid PNG file with the given dimensions and argb colour.
  yk_write_png(path.cstring, cint(w), cint(h), argb)

proc imageInfo*(path: string): (int, int) =
  ## Queries image dimensions (width, height) without full draw.
  var w, h: cint
  if yk_image_info(path.cstring, addr w, addr h):
    (int(w), int(h))
  else:
    (0, 0)

proc drawImage*(c: Canvas; path: string; x, y, w, h, r: float32; fit: int = 0) =
  ## Draws an image with contain (fit=0), cover (fit=1), or fill (fit=2) and optional corner radius r.
  yk_draw_image(pointer(c), path.cstring, x, y, w, h, r, cint(fit))


# --- the image pipeline (P2): decode off the UI thread, at the drawn size, LRU-capped ------
proc yk_img_draw(c: pointer; path: cstring; x, y, w, h, r: cfloat; fit: cint; alpha: cfloat; tMs: cdouble;
                 level, sync: cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_image_frames(path: cstring): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_img_generation(): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_img_cache_limit(bytes: clonglong) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_img_stats(count: ptr cint; bytes: ptr clonglong; pending: ptr cint) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_img_wait(timeoutMs: cint): bool {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_img_forget(path: cstring) {.importc, cdecl.}

const
  imgFailed* = -1     ## not an image Skia can decode (nothing drawn)
  imgLoading* = 0     ## queued or decoding: nothing drawn yet
  imgDrawn* = 1       ## drawn at the right size
  imgAnimated* = 2    ## drawn; animated, so draw again for the next frame
  imgStandIn* = 3     ## drawn from another size while the right one decodes

proc drawImageAsync*(c: Canvas; path: string; x, y, w, h, r: float32; fit = 0; alpha = 1'f32; tMs = 0.0;
                     sync = false; level = -1): int =
  ## Draws from the image cache. The decode size is the smallest power-of-two reduction
  ## covering the size the image lands on the device (`level` >= 0 forces one: 0 = full).
  ## Not cached yet: `sync` decodes now; otherwise a worker decodes it (see the constants).
  ## `tMs` picks an animated image's frame; `alpha` fades it.
  int(yk_img_draw(pointer(c), path.cstring, x, y, w, h, r, cint(fit), alpha, tMs, cint(level), cint(sync)))

proc imageFrames*(path: string): int = int(yk_image_frames(path.cstring))
  ## 1 for a still, more for an animation, 0 if Skia can't read it (header only).
proc imageGeneration*(): int = int(yk_img_generation())
  ## Bumps whenever a background decode finishes: images that were loading can draw now.
proc setImageCacheLimit*(bytes: int) = yk_img_cache_limit(clonglong(bytes))
  ## The decoded-pixel budget (default 128 MB); least recently drawn images go first.
proc imageCacheStats*(): tuple[count: int, bytes: int, pending: int] =
  var c, p: cint
  var b: clonglong
  yk_img_stats(addr c, addr b, addr p)
  (int(c), int(b), int(p))
proc waitImages*(timeoutMs = 5000): bool = yk_img_wait(cint(timeoutMs))
  ## Blocks until every queued decode is done (tests); false on timeout.
proc forgetImage*(path: string) = yk_img_forget(path.cstring)
  ## Drops what is cached for a file that changed.

# --- canvas node (P7) --------------------------------------------------------------------
proc yk_canvas_run(c: pointer; cmds: cstring; len: cint; ox, oy, w, h: cfloat; assetDir: cstring; tMs: cdouble): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc drawCommands*(c: Canvas; cmds: string; x, y, w, h: float32; assetDir: string; tMs = 0.0): bool =
  ## Replays a canvas node's command list (format: skia_shim.cpp, yk_canvas_run) at (x, y),
  ## clipped to w x h. True if an image in it is loading or animated (draw again later).
  yk_canvas_run(pointer(c), cmds.cstring, cint(cmds.len), x, y, w, h, assetDir.cstring, tMs) == 1

proc yk_save_pixels(path: cstring; bgra: pointer; w, h: cint): bool {.importc, cdecl.}
proc savePixels*(path: string; bgra: pointer; w, h: int): bool = yk_save_pixels(path.cstring, bgra, cint(w), cint(h))
  ## Writes BGRA pixels to a .png (or .jpg/.jpeg) file.

proc yk_text_placeholders(s: cstring; len: cint; size: cfloat; weight: cint; maxW: cfloat; align: cint; family: cstring;
                          italic: cint; lineHeight: cfloat; maxLines: cint; outp: ptr cfloat; max: cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc inlineRects*(s: string; size: float32; weight: int; maxW: float32; align: int; st: TextStyle): seq[(float32, float32, float32, float32)] =
  ## Where the text's inline objects (its U+FFFC characters, sized by `st.inline`) were laid out.
  var buf: array[256, cfloat]
  let n = yk_text_placeholders(s.cstring, cint(s.len), size, cint(weight), maxW, cint(align), st.fam.cstring,
                               cint(st.italic), st.lineHeight, cint(st.maxLines), addr buf[0], 64)
  for i in 0 ..< int(n): result.add (float32(buf[4*i]), float32(buf[4*i+1]), float32(buf[4*i+2]), float32(buf[4*i+3]))

# --- raster layers and bulk pixels (CV2) ----------------------------------------------------
proc yk_canvas_env(layerBase: cint; bufFn: pointer) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_new(id, w, h: cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_free(id: cint) {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_draw(id: cint; cmds: cstring; len: cint; assetDir: cstring): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_filter(id, kind: cint; amount: cfloat): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_read(id, x, y, w, h: cint; o: pointer): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_write(id, x, y, w, h: cint; i: pointer): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc yk_layer_size(id: cint; w, h: ptr cint): cint {.importc, cdecl.}
proc canvasEnv*(layerBase: int; bufFn: pointer) = yk_canvas_env(cint(layerBase), bufFn)
  ## Before drawing an app's canvases: its layer ids' offset, and how 'X' finds a buffer's
  ## bytes (`proc (id: cint; len: ptr cint): pointer {.cdecl.}`).
proc newLayer*(id, w, h: int): bool = yk_layer_new(cint(id), cint(w), cint(h)) == 1
  ## A transparent w x h bitmap under global id `id` (replaces one with that id).
proc freeLayer*(id: int) = yk_layer_free(cint(id))
proc drawLayer*(id: int; cmds, assetDir: string): bool =
  ## Draws a canvas command list into layer `id`, where it stays.
  yk_layer_draw(cint(id), cmds.cstring, cint(cmds.len), assetDir.cstring) == 1
proc filterLayer*(id, kind: int; amount: float32): bool = yk_layer_filter(cint(id), cint(kind), amount) == 1
  ## In place: 0 blur px, 1 brightness, 2 contrast, 3 saturation, 4 invert, 5 grey, 6 sepia, 7 opacity.
proc readLayer*(id, x, y, w, h: int): string =
  ## w x h RGBA (not premultiplied) from (x, y); "" if there is no such layer.
  result = newString(max(0, w * h * 4))
  if result.len == 0 or yk_layer_read(cint(id), cint(x), cint(y), cint(w), cint(h), addr result[0]) != 1: result = ""
proc writeLayer*(id, x, y, w, h: int; rgba: string): bool =
  rgba.len >= w * h * 4 and w > 0 and h > 0 and
    yk_layer_write(cint(id), cint(x), cint(y), cint(w), cint(h), unsafeAddr rgba[0]) == 1
proc layerSize*(id: int): (int, int) =
  var w, h: cint
  if yk_layer_size(cint(id), addr w, addr h) == 1: (int(w), int(h)) else: (0, 0)

// skia_shim.cpp — a small C API over Skia for the Yantra native engine.
//
// Only what the renderer needs: a raster canvas over caller-owned pixels, filled
// and stroked rounded rects, clipping, and paragraph text (SkParagraph, which
// shapes with HarfBuzz and handles bidi and fallback — Hindi works). Paragraphs
// are cached by (text, size, weight, max width) because layout is the expensive
// part and the same labels are drawn every frame.

#include "include/core/SkCanvas.h"
#include "include/core/SkColor.h"
#include "include/core/SkFontMgr.h"
#include "include/core/SkFontStyle.h"
#include "include/core/SkImageInfo.h"
#include "include/core/SkPaint.h"
#include "include/core/SkPathBuilder.h"
#include "include/core/SkMaskFilter.h"
#include "include/core/SkBlurTypes.h"
#include "include/effects/SkGradientShader.h"
#include <map>
#include "include/utils/SkParsePath.h"
#include <cmath>
#include "include/core/SkRRect.h"
#include "include/core/SkSurface.h"
#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
#include "include/ports/SkFontMgr_empty.h"
#include "modules/skparagraph/include/TypefaceFontProvider.h"
#include <dirent.h>
#else
#include "include/ports/SkTypeface_win.h"
#endif
#include "modules/skparagraph/include/FontCollection.h"
#include "modules/skparagraph/include/Paragraph.h"
#include "modules/skparagraph/include/ParagraphBuilder.h"
#include "modules/skparagraph/include/ParagraphStyle.h"
#include "modules/skparagraph/include/TextStyle.h"
#include "modules/skunicode/include/SkUnicode_icu.h"

#include <list>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>

using namespace skia::textlayout;

namespace {

struct Fonts {
  sk_sp<SkFontMgr> mgr;
  sk_sp<FontCollection> collection;
  sk_sp<SkUnicode> unicode;
  // LRU paragraph cache
  std::list<std::string> order;
  std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::unique_ptr<Paragraph>, std::list<std::string>::iterator>> cache;
  size_t capacity = 512;
};

Fonts* g_fonts = nullptr;

Fonts* fonts() {
  if (!g_fonts) {
    g_fonts = new Fonts();
    g_fonts->collection = sk_make_sp<FontCollection>();
#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
    // The browser has no font manager Skia can use: the page ships open fonts in /fonts
    // (sans.ttf, mono.ttf, and any others), registered under the names the engine asks for.
    g_fonts->mgr = SkFontMgr_New_Custom_Empty();
    auto provider = sk_make_sp<TypefaceFontProvider>();
    if (DIR* d = opendir("/fonts")) {
      while (dirent* e = readdir(d)) {
        std::string name = e->d_name;
        if (name.size() < 5) continue;
        sk_sp<SkTypeface> tf = g_fonts->mgr->makeFromFile(("/fonts/" + name).c_str());
        if (!tf) continue;
        provider->registerTypeface(tf);
        bool mono = name.rfind("mono", 0) == 0;
        for (const char* alias : mono ? std::initializer_list<const char*>{"Cascadia Mono", "Consolas"}
                                      : std::initializer_list<const char*>{"Segoe UI", "Nirmala UI"})
          provider->registerTypeface(tf, SkString(alias));
      }
      closedir(d);
    }
    g_fonts->collection->setDefaultFontManager(provider);
#else
    g_fonts->mgr = SkFontMgr_New_DirectWrite();
    g_fonts->collection->setDefaultFontManager(g_fonts->mgr);
#endif
    g_fonts->collection->enableFontFallback();
    g_fonts->unicode = SkUnicodes::ICU::Make();
  }
  return g_fonts;
}

struct TextOpts {
  const char* family = nullptr;   // nullptr = the default stack
  int italic = 0;
  float lineHeight = 0;           // multiple of the font size; 0 = the font's own
  int maxLines = 0;               // 0 = unlimited; otherwise ellipsised
};

std::string key(const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW, unsigned argb, int align,
                const TextOpts& o) {
  std::string k(s, (size_t)len);
  k.push_back('\x1f');
  k += std::to_string(size) + "|" + std::to_string(weight) + "|" + std::to_string(maxW) + "|" +
       std::to_string(argb) + "|" + std::to_string(align) + "|" + (o.family ? o.family : "") + "|" +
       std::to_string(o.italic) + "|" + std::to_string(o.lineHeight) + "|" + std::to_string(o.maxLines);
  return k;
}

Paragraph* paragraph(const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW, unsigned argb, int align,
                     const TextOpts& o = TextOpts()) {
  Fonts* f = fonts();
  std::string k = key(s, len, size, weight, maxW, argb, align, o);
  auto it = f->cache.find(k);
  if (it != f->cache.end()) {
    f->order.splice(f->order.begin(), f->order, it->second.second);
    return it->second.first.get();
  }
  ParagraphStyle ps;
  ps.setTextAlign(align == 1 ? TextAlign::kCenter : align == 2 ? TextAlign::kRight : TextAlign::kLeft);
  bool rtl = o.family && o.family[0] == '\x1d';     // right-to-left (P9): nimskia TextStyle.rtl
  if (rtl) {
    ps.setTextDirection(TextDirection::kRtl);
    // align 0 is "start": the right edge, when the paragraph has a width to align in
    ps.setTextAlign(align == 1 ? TextAlign::kCenter : align == 2 ? TextAlign::kLeft : maxW > 0 ? TextAlign::kRight : TextAlign::kLeft);
  }
  TextStyle ts;
  ts.setFontSize(size);
  ts.setColor(SkColor(argb));
  // rich text: the family string may carry styled runs after a \x1e (see nimskia TextStyle.spans):
  // "start,end,flags,argb,size;…" in bytes; flags 1 bold, 2 italic, 4 underline, 8 strike, 16 mono
  std::string fam = o.family ? o.family + (rtl ? 1 : 0) : "";
  std::string inl;                               // inline objects (Q3): "w,h;w,h" after a \x1c
  size_t isep = fam.find('\x1c');
  if (isep != std::string::npos) { inl = fam.substr(isep + 1); fam = fam.substr(0, isep); }
  std::string spans;
  size_t sep = fam.find('\x1e');
  if (sep != std::string::npos) { spans = fam.substr(sep + 1); fam = fam.substr(0, sep); }
  if (!fam.empty())
    ts.setFontFamilies({SkString(fam.c_str()), SkString("Segoe UI"), SkString("Nirmala UI"), SkString("Segoe UI Emoji")});
  else
    ts.setFontFamilies({SkString("Segoe UI"), SkString("Nirmala UI"), SkString("Segoe UI Emoji")});
  ts.setFontStyle(SkFontStyle(weight, SkFontStyle::kNormal_Width,
                              o.italic ? SkFontStyle::kItalic_Slant : SkFontStyle::kUpright_Slant));
  if (o.lineHeight > 0) { ts.setHeight(o.lineHeight); ts.setHeightOverride(true); }
  ps.setTextStyle(ts);
  if (o.maxLines > 0) { ps.setMaxLines((size_t)o.maxLines); ps.setEllipsis(u"\u2026"); }
  auto builder = ParagraphBuilder::make(ps, f->collection, f->unicode);
  builder->pushStyle(ts);
  // each U+FFFC in the text becomes the next inline object's box (an image or emoji the
  // engine draws there): a placeholder is one UTF-16 unit, like the character, so byte
  // offsets map the same
  std::vector<std::pair<float, float>> boxes;
  for (size_t q = 0; q < inl.size();) {
    size_t e = inl.find(';', q);
    if (e == std::string::npos) e = inl.size();
    float bw = 0, bh = 0;
    if (sscanf(inl.substr(q, e - q).c_str(), "%f,%f", &bw, &bh) == 2) boxes.push_back({bw, bh});
    q = e + 1;
  }
  size_t nextBox = 0;
  auto addRun = [&](const char* t, size_t n) {
    size_t from = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; boxes.size() > nextBox && i + 2 < n + 0 && i + 3 <= n; ++i) {
      if ((unsigned char)t[i] == 0xEF && (unsigned char)t[i + 1] == 0xBF && (unsigned char)t[i + 2] == 0xBC) {
        if (i > from) builder->addText(t + from, i - from);
        auto bx = boxes[nextBox++];
        builder->addPlaceholder(PlaceholderStyle(bx.first, bx.second, PlaceholderAlignment::kMiddle,
                                                 TextBaseline::kAlphabetic, 0));
        from = i + 3;
        i += 2;
        if (nextBox >= boxes.size()) break;
      }
    }
    if (n > from) builder->addText(t + from, n - from);
  };
  if (spans.empty()) {
    addRun(s, (size_t)len);
  } else {
    size_t at = 0, pos = 0;
    while (pos < spans.size()) {
      size_t end = spans.find(';', pos);
      if (end == std::string::npos) end = spans.size();
      long a = 0, b = 0, flags = 0, size2 = 0; unsigned long col = 0;
      if (sscanf(spans.substr(pos, end - pos).c_str(), "%ld,%ld,%ld,%lu,%ld", &a, &b, &flags, &col, &size2) >= 3 &&
          a >= (long)at && b > a && b <= len) {
        if ((size_t)a > at) addRun(s + at, (size_t)a - at);
        TextStyle rs = ts;
        if (flags & 1) rs.setFontStyle(SkFontStyle(700, SkFontStyle::kNormal_Width, rs.getFontStyle().slant()));
        if (flags & 2) rs.setFontStyle(SkFontStyle(rs.getFontStyle().weight(), SkFontStyle::kNormal_Width, SkFontStyle::kItalic_Slant));
        int deco = 0;
        if (flags & 4) deco |= TextDecoration::kUnderline;
        if (flags & 8) deco |= TextDecoration::kLineThrough;
        if (deco) { rs.setDecoration((TextDecoration)deco); rs.setDecorationColor(col ? SkColor(col) : SkColor(argb)); }
        if (flags & 16) rs.setFontFamilies({SkString("Cascadia Mono"), SkString("Consolas"), SkString("Segoe UI")});
        if (col) rs.setColor(SkColor(col));
        if (size2 > 0) rs.setFontSize((float)size2);
        builder->pushStyle(rs);
        addRun(s + a, (size_t)(b - a));
        builder->pop();
        at = (size_t)b;
      }
      pos = end + 1;
    }
    if (at < (size_t)len) addRun(s + at, (size_t)len - at);
  }
  auto p = builder->Build();
  p->layout(maxW > 0 ? maxW : 1e6f);
  Paragraph* raw = p.get();
  f->order.push_front(k);
  f->cache.emplace(k, std::make_pair(std::move(p), f->order.begin()));
  if (f->cache.size() > f->capacity) {
    f->cache.erase(f->order.back());
    f->order.pop_back();
  }
  return raw;
}

}  // namespace

extern "C" {

void* yk_canvas_new(void* pixels, int w, int h, int rowBytes) {
  SkImageInfo info = SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(w, h);
  auto c = SkCanvas::MakeRasterDirect(info, pixels, (size_t)rowBytes);
  return c.release();
}

void yk_canvas_free(void* c) { delete static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c); }

void yk_clear(void* c, unsigned argb) { static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->clear(SkColor(argb)); }

void yk_save(void* c) { static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->save(); }
void yk_restore(void* c) { static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->restore(); }
void yk_translate(void* c, float x, float y) { static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->translate(x, y); }
void yk_scale(void* c, float s) { static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->scale(s, s); }
void yk_rotate(void* c, float deg) { static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->rotate(deg); }
void yk_clip_rect(void* c, float x, float y, float w, float h) {
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->clipRect(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x, y, w, h), true);
}

void yk_rrect(void* c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, unsigned argb) {
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setColor(SkColor(argb));
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->drawRRect(SkRRect::MakeRectXY(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x, y, w, h), r, r), p);
}

void yk_rrect_stroke(void* c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float width, unsigned argb) {
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setStyle(SkPaint::kStroke_Style);
  p.setStrokeWidth(width);
  p.setColor(SkColor(argb));
  float i = width / 2;
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->drawRRect(
      SkRRect::MakeRectXY(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x + i, y + i, w - width, h - width), r, r), p);
}

// Strokes an open polyline (xy pairs) with round caps and joins: ticks, chevrons.
void yk_polyline(void* c, const float* xy, int n, float width, unsigned argb) {
  if (n < 2) return;
  SkPathBuilder b;
  b.moveTo(xy[0], xy[1]);
  for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) b.lineTo(xy[2 * i], xy[2 * i + 1]);
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setStyle(SkPaint::kStroke_Style);
  p.setStrokeWidth(width);
  p.setStrokeCap(SkPaint::kRound_Cap);
  p.setStrokeJoin(SkPaint::kRound_Join);
  p.setColor(SkColor(argb));
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->drawPath(b.detach(), p);
}

// Measures a paragraph laid out at maxW (<= 0 means unbounded). Returns the
// width the text actually needs; *outH receives its height.
float yk_text_measure(const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW, float* outH) {
  if (len <= 0) { if (outH) *outH = size * 1.2f; return 0; }
  Paragraph* p = paragraph(s, len, size, weight, maxW, 0xff000000u, 0);
  if (outH) *outH = p->getHeight();
  float w = p->getMaxIntrinsicWidth();
  if (maxW > 0 && w > maxW) w = maxW;
  return w;
}

void yk_text_draw(void* c, const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW,
                  float x, float y, unsigned argb, int align) {
  if (len <= 0) return;
  Paragraph* p = paragraph(s, len, size, weight, maxW, argb, align);
  p->paint(static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c), x, y);
}

// X offset of the caret after `bytes` bytes of text (for text inputs).
float yk_text_caret_x(const char* s, int len, int bytes, float size, int weight) {
  if (bytes <= 0 || len <= 0) return 0;
  if (bytes > len) bytes = len;
  float h = 0;
  return yk_text_measure(s, bytes, size, weight, 0, &h);
}

}  // extern "C"

extern "C" {

// Text with every option. Returns width; *outH gets the height.
float yk_text_measure2(const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW, float* outH,
                       const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight, int maxLines) {
  TextOpts o; o.family = family; o.italic = italic; o.lineHeight = lineHeight; o.maxLines = maxLines;
  if (len <= 0) { if (outH) *outH = size * (lineHeight > 0 ? lineHeight : 1.2f); return 0; }
  Paragraph* p = paragraph(s, len, size, weight, maxW, 0xff000000u, 0, o);
  if (outH) *outH = p->getHeight();
  float w = p->getMaxIntrinsicWidth();
  if (maxW > 0 && w > maxW) w = maxW;
  return w;
}

void yk_text_draw2(void* c, const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW,
                   float x, float y, unsigned argb, int align,
                   const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight, int maxLines) {
  if (len <= 0) return;
  TextOpts o; o.family = family; o.italic = italic; o.lineHeight = lineHeight; o.maxLines = maxLines;
  Paragraph* p = paragraph(s, len, size, weight, maxW, argb, align, o);
  p->paint(static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c), x, y);
}

// --- text editing geometry (T1). Positions are UTF-8 byte offsets on our side and
// UTF-16 code units inside SkParagraph; these two convert.
static int u8to16(const char* s, int len, int bytes) {
  int u = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < len && i < bytes;) {
    unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[i];
    int n = c < 0x80 ? 1 : c < 0xE0 ? 2 : c < 0xF0 ? 3 : 4;
    u += n == 4 ? 2 : 1;
    i += n;
  }
  return u;
}
static int u16to8(const char* s, int len, int u16) {
  int u = 0, i = 0;
  while (i < len && u < u16) {
    unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[i];
    int n = c < 0x80 ? 1 : c < 0xE0 ? 2 : c < 0xF0 ? 3 : 4;
    u += n == 4 ? 2 : 1;
    i += n;
  }
  return i > len ? len : i;
}
static Paragraph* editPara(const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW,
                           const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight) {
  TextOpts o; o.family = family; o.italic = italic; o.lineHeight = lineHeight;
  return paragraph(s, len, size, weight, maxW, 0xff000000u, 0, o);
}

// Where the caret goes after `bytes` bytes: top-left x, y and its height. Handles
// wrapped and hard-broken ("\n") lines and right-to-left runs.
void yk_text_caret(const char* s, int len, int bytes, float size, int weight, float maxW,
                   const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight, float* ox, float* oy, float* oh) {
  float lh = size * (lineHeight > 0 ? lineHeight : 1.2f);
  *ox = 0; *oy = 0; *oh = lh;
  if (len <= 0) return;
  if (bytes > len) bytes = len;
  if (bytes < 0) bytes = 0;
  Paragraph* p = editPara(s, len, size, weight, maxW, family, italic, lineHeight);
  int i = u8to16(s, len, bytes), n = u8to16(s, len, len);
  bool afterBreak = bytes > 0 && s[bytes - 1] == '\n';
  if (i < n && (i == 0 || afterBreak)) {                 // left edge of the next character
    auto r = p->getRectsForRange(i, i + 1, RectHeightStyle::kMax, RectWidthStyle::kTight);
    if (!r.empty()) {
      bool rtl = r[0].direction == TextDirection::kRtl;
      *ox = rtl ? r[0].rect.fRight : r[0].rect.fLeft; *oy = r[0].rect.fTop; *oh = r[0].rect.height();
      return;
    }
  }
  if (afterBreak) {                                      // an empty last line
    *ox = 0; *oy = p->getHeight() - lh; *oh = lh;
    return;
  }
  if (i > 0) {                                           // right edge of the previous character
    auto r = p->getRectsForRange(i - 1, i, RectHeightStyle::kMax, RectWidthStyle::kTight);
    if (!r.empty()) {
      bool rtl = r.back().direction == TextDirection::kRtl;
      *ox = rtl ? r.back().rect.fLeft : r.back().rect.fRight; *oy = r.back().rect.fTop; *oh = r.back().rect.height();
    }
  }
}

// The byte offset nearest to point (x, y) in the laid-out text.
int yk_text_hit(const char* s, int len, float x, float y, float size, int weight, float maxW,
                const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight) {
  if (len <= 0) return 0;
  Paragraph* p = editPara(s, len, size, weight, maxW, family, italic, lineHeight);
  auto pos = p->getGlyphPositionAtCoordinate(x, y);
  return u16to8(s, len, pos.position);
}

// Rectangles covering bytes [from, to): up to maxRects of them as x, y, w, h.
int yk_text_rects(const char* s, int len, int from, int to, float size, int weight, float maxW,
                  const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight, float* out, int maxRects) {
  if (len <= 0 || to <= from) return 0;
  Paragraph* p = editPara(s, len, size, weight, maxW, family, italic, lineHeight);
  auto r = p->getRectsForRange(u8to16(s, len, from), u8to16(s, len, to), RectHeightStyle::kMax,
                               RectWidthStyle::kTight);
  int n = 0;
  for (auto& b : r) {
    if (n >= maxRects) break;
    out[4 * n] = b.rect.fLeft; out[4 * n + 1] = b.rect.fTop;
    out[4 * n + 2] = b.rect.width(); out[4 * n + 3] = b.rect.height();
    n++;
  }
  return n;
}

// Where the inline objects (U+FFFC boxes, Q3) landed: up to max of them as x, y, w, h.
int yk_text_placeholders(const char* s, int len, float size, int weight, float maxW, int align,
                         const char* family, int italic, float lineHeight, int maxLines, float* out, int max) {
  if (len <= 0) return 0;
  TextOpts o; o.family = family; o.italic = italic; o.lineHeight = lineHeight; o.maxLines = maxLines;
  Paragraph* p = paragraph(s, len, size, weight, maxW, 0xff000000u, align, o);
  auto r = p->getRectsForPlaceholders();
  int n = 0;
  for (auto& b : r) {
    if (n >= max) break;
    out[4 * n] = b.rect.fLeft; out[4 * n + 1] = b.rect.fTop;
    out[4 * n + 2] = b.rect.width(); out[4 * n + 3] = b.rect.height();
    n++;
  }
  return n;
}

// A rounded rect filled with a linear gradient; angle in degrees, 90 = top to bottom.
void yk_rrect_gradient(void* c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r,
                       unsigned from, unsigned to, float angleDeg) {
  float a = angleDeg * 3.14159265f / 180.f;
  float cx = x + w / 2, cy = y + h / 2;
  float dx = std::cos(a) * w / 2, dy = std::sin(a) * h / 2;
  SkPoint pts[2] = {{cx - dx, cy - dy}, {cx + dx, cy + dy}};
  SkColor cols[2] = {SkColor(from), SkColor(to)};
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setShader(SkGradientShader::MakeLinear(pts, cols, nullptr, 2, SkTileMode::kClamp));
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->drawRRect(SkRRect::MakeRectXY(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x, y, w, h), r, r), p);
}

// A soft shadow under a rounded rect: the shape offset by (dx, dy), blurred by `blur`.
void yk_shadow(void* c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r,
               float dx, float dy, float blur, unsigned argb) {
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setColor(SkColor(argb));
  if (blur > 0) p.setMaskFilter(SkMaskFilter::MakeBlur(kNormal_SkBlurStyle, blur / 2));
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->drawRRect(SkRRect::MakeRectXY(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x + dx, y + dy, w, h), r, r), p);
}

// Group opacity: everything drawn until the matching restore is faded together.
void yk_save_alpha(void* c, float alpha) {
  int a = (int)std::lround(alpha * 255.f);
  if (a < 0) a = 0;
  if (a > 255) a = 255;
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->saveLayerAlpha(nullptr, (U8CPU)a);
}

// SVG path data drawn at (x, y), scaled by `scale`; stroked when strokeWidth > 0, else filled.
// Parsed paths are cached by their text.
void yk_svg_path(void* c, const char* d, float x, float y, float scale, float strokeWidth, unsigned argb) {
  static std::unordered_map<std::string, SkPath> cache;
  std::string key(d ? d : "");
  auto it = cache.find(key);
  if (it == cache.end()) {
    auto parsed = SkParsePath::FromSVGString(key.c_str());
    if (!parsed) return;
    it = cache.emplace(key, *parsed).first;
  }
  SkCanvas* cv = static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c);
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setColor(SkColor(argb));
  if (strokeWidth > 0) {
    p.setStyle(SkPaint::kStroke_Style);
    p.setStrokeWidth(strokeWidth);
    p.setStrokeCap(SkPaint::kRound_Cap);
    p.setStrokeJoin(SkPaint::kRound_Join);
  }
  cv->save();
  cv->translate(x, y);
  cv->scale(scale, scale);
  cv->drawPath(it->second, p);
  cv->restore();
}

}  // extern "C"

// --- U8: pixels from elsewhere (decoded video frames) -------------------------------
#include "include/core/SkImage.h"
#include "include/core/SkPixmap.h"
#include "include/core/SkSamplingOptions.h"

extern "C" {

// Draws a BGRA pixel buffer (pw x ph, opaque) into the box x, y, w, h: fit 0 contain,
// 1 cover, 2 fill (stretch); corners rounded by r. The pixels are not copied.
void yk_draw_pixels(void* c, const void* pixels, int pw, int ph, float x, float y, float w, float h,
                    float r, int fit) {
  if (!pixels || pw <= 0 || ph <= 0 || w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;
  SkPixmap pm(SkImageInfo::Make(pw, ph, kBGRA_8888_SkColorType, kPremul_SkAlphaType), pixels, (size_t)pw * 4);  // premultiplied: 3D frames are transparent around the model
  sk_sp<SkImage> img = SkImages::RasterFromPixmap(pm, nullptr, nullptr);
  if (!img) return;
  SkCanvas* cv = static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c);
  SkRect box = SkRect::MakeXYWH(x, y, w, h);
  SkRect dst = box;
  if (fit != 2) {
    float s = fit == 1 ? std::max(w / pw, h / ph) : std::min(w / pw, h / ph);
    float dw = pw * s, dh = ph * s;
    dst = SkRect::MakeXYWH(x + (w - dw) / 2, y + (h - dh) / 2, dw, dh);
  }
  cv->save();
  cv->clipRRect(SkRRect::MakeRectXY(box, r, r), true);
  cv->drawImageRect(img, dst, SkSamplingOptions(SkFilterMode::kLinear, SkMipmapMode::kNone));
  cv->restore();
}

}  // extern "C"

// --- FX1: effects as props (blur, glass, blend, colour, SkSL shaders) -----------------
#include "include/effects/SkImageFilters.h"
#include "include/effects/SkRuntimeEffect.h"
#include "include/effects/SkColorMatrix.h"
#include "include/core/SkColorFilter.h"
#include "include/core/SkBlendMode.h"
#include "include/core/SkM44.h"

namespace {
struct ShaderEntry { sk_sp<SkRuntimeEffect> effect; std::string error; };
std::unordered_map<std::string, ShaderEntry> g_shaders;

ShaderEntry& shaderFor(const char* src) {
  std::string k(src);
  auto it = g_shaders.find(k);
  if (it != g_shaders.end()) return it->second;
  auto result = SkRuntimeEffect::MakeForShader(SkString(src));
  ShaderEntry e{result.effect, result.effect ? "" : std::string(result.errorText.c_str())};
  return g_shaders.emplace(k, e).first->second;
}
}  // namespace

extern "C" {

// Starts a layer for a node's effects; everything drawn until the matching restores goes
// through it. blur: blur of the node itself (px); backdrop: blur of what is behind it
// inside x,y,w,h rounded by r (frosted glass); blend: an SkBlendMode (-1 = normal);
// saturate/brightness/contrast: 1 = unchanged; alpha: the node's opacity. Returns how
// many restores it needs (1 or 2).
int yk_save_fx(void* c, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float blur, float backdrop, int blend,
               float saturate, float brightness, float contrast, float alpha) {
  SkCanvas* cv = static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c);
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAlphaf(alpha < 0 ? 0 : alpha > 1 ? 1 : alpha);
  if (blur > 0) p.setImageFilter(SkImageFilters::Blur(blur / 2, blur / 2, SkTileMode::kDecal, nullptr));
  if (saturate != 1 || brightness != 1 || contrast != 1) {
    SkColorMatrix m;
    m.setSaturation(saturate);
    SkColorMatrix bc;                    // brightness and contrast around mid grey
    float s = brightness * contrast, t = 0.5f * (1 - contrast);
    bc.setScale(s, s, s, 1);
    bc.postTranslate(t, t, t, 0);
    m.postConcat(bc);
    p.setColorFilter(SkColorFilters::Matrix(m));
  }
  if (blend >= 0 && blend <= (int)SkBlendMode::kLastMode) p.setBlendMode((SkBlendMode)blend);
  int saves = 1;
  if (backdrop > 0) {
    cv->save();
    cv->clipRRect(SkRRect::MakeRectXY(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x, y, w, h), r, r), true);
    saves = 2;
    auto bf = SkImageFilters::Blur(backdrop / 2, backdrop / 2, SkTileMode::kClamp, nullptr);
    cv->saveLayer(SkCanvas::SaveLayerRec(nullptr, &p, bf.get(), 0));
  } else {
    cv->saveLayer(nullptr, &p);
  }
  return saves;
}

// Fills a rounded rect with an SkSL shader. Its coordinates are local to the box; it may
// declare `uniform float2 size;` and `uniform float time;` (seconds). 1 on success, else 0
// with the compile error in err.
int yk_shader_rrect(void* c, const char* src, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float time,
                    char* err, int cap) {
  ShaderEntry& e = shaderFor(src);
  if (!e.effect) {
    snprintf(err, (size_t)cap, "%s", e.error.c_str());
    return 0;
  }
  SkRuntimeShaderBuilder b(e.effect);
  if (b.uniform("size").fVar) b.uniform("size") = SkV2{w, h};
  if (b.uniform("time").fVar) b.uniform("time") = time;
  SkMatrix local = SkMatrix::Translate(x, y);
  auto shader = b.makeShader(&local);
  if (!shader) { snprintf(err, (size_t)cap, "the shader could not be made"); return 0; }
  SkPaint p;
  p.setAntiAlias(true);
  p.setShader(shader);
  static_cast<SkCanvas*>(c)->drawRRect(SkRRect::MakeRectXY(SkRect::MakeXYWH(x, y, w, h), r, r), p);
  return 1;
}

// Whether a shader reads `time` (then it animates); -1 if it does not compile.
int yk_shader_uses_time(const char* src) {
  ShaderEntry& e = shaderFor(src);
  if (!e.effect) return -1;
  return e.effect->findUniform("time") ? 1 : 0;
}

}  // extern "C"

#ifndef __EMSCRIPTEN__   // PDF and GPU are desktop-only for now
// --- D1: PDF documents (vector, real text) -----------------------------------------
#include "include/docs/SkPDFDocument.h"
#include "include/docs/SkPDFJpegHelpers.h"
#include "include/core/SkStream.h"

namespace {
struct YkPdf {
  std::unique_ptr<SkFILEWStream> stream;
  sk_sp<SkDocument> doc;
};
}  // namespace

extern "C" {

// Opens `path` for a PDF; nullptr if the file cannot be written.
void* yk_pdf_open(const char* path, const char* title, const char* author) {
  auto s = std::make_unique<SkFILEWStream>(path);
  if (!s->isValid()) return nullptr;
  SkPDF::Metadata m = SkPDF::JPEG::MetadataWithCallbacks();   // photos go in as JPEG
  m.fTitle = title;
  m.fAuthor = author;
  m.fCreator = "Yantra";
  m.fProducer = "Yantra (Skia PDF)";
  auto doc = SkPDF::MakeDocument(s.get(), m);
  if (!doc) return nullptr;
  return new YkPdf{std::move(s), doc};
}

// Starts a page of w x h points; returns the canvas to draw it with (owned by the document).
void* yk_pdf_page(void* h, float w, float hgt) {
  return static_cast<YkPdf*>(h)->doc->beginPage(w, hgt);
}

void yk_pdf_end_page(void* h) { static_cast<YkPdf*>(h)->doc->endPage(); }

// Finishes the file and frees the document.
void yk_pdf_close(void* h) {
  auto* y = static_cast<YkPdf*>(h);
  y->doc->close();
  y->stream->flush();
  delete y;
}

}  // extern "C"

// --- U5: the GPU (Ganesh on OpenGL) ---------------------------------------------------
#include "include/gpu/ganesh/GrDirectContext.h"
#include "include/gpu/ganesh/GrBackendSurface.h"
#include "include/gpu/ganesh/SkSurfaceGanesh.h"
#include "include/gpu/ganesh/gl/GrGLDirectContext.h"

#include "include/gpu/ganesh/gl/GrGLTypes.h"

extern "C" {

// A GPU context on the OpenGL context current on this thread; nullptr if none.
void* yk_gpu_new() {
  auto iface = GrGLMakeNativeInterface();
  if (!iface) return nullptr;
  return GrDirectContexts::MakeGL(iface).release();
}

void yk_gpu_free(void* ctx) { if (ctx) static_cast<GrDirectContext*>(ctx)->unref(); }

// A surface on the window's default framebuffer (w x h device pixels).
void* yk_gpu_window_surface(void* ctx, int w, int h) {
  GrGLFramebufferInfo fb;
  fb.fFBOID = 0;
  fb.fFormat = 0x8058;                    // GL_RGBA8
  auto rt = GrBackendRenderTargets::MakeGL(w, h, 0, 8, fb);
  return SkSurfaces::WrapBackendRenderTarget(static_cast<GrDirectContext*>(ctx), rt, kBottomLeft_GrSurfaceOrigin,
                                             kRGBA_8888_SkColorType, nullptr, nullptr).release();
}

// An off-screen GPU surface (for tests, thumbnails and GPU film frames).
void* yk_gpu_offscreen(void* ctx, int w, int h) {
  return SkSurfaces::RenderTarget(static_cast<GrDirectContext*>(ctx), skgpu::Budgeted::kNo,
                                  SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(w, h)).release();
}

void* yk_surface_canvas(void* s) { return static_cast<SkSurface*>(s)->getCanvas(); }
void yk_surface_free(void* s) { if (s) static_cast<SkSurface*>(s)->unref(); }

// Sends the frame's GPU work; `sync` waits until it is done (for timing and read-back).
void yk_gpu_flush(void* ctx, int sync) {
  static_cast<GrDirectContext*>(ctx)->flushAndSubmit(sync ? GrSyncCpu::kYes : GrSyncCpu::kNo);
}

// Copies a surface's pixels (BGRA premultiplied, w x h) into `pixels`. 1 on success.
int yk_surface_read(void* s, void* pixels, int w, int h) {
  return static_cast<SkSurface*>(s)->readPixels(SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(w, h), pixels, (size_t)w * 4, 0, 0) ? 1 : 0;
}

}  // extern "C"
